title: KU student from Lawrence named Astronaut Scholar
summary_en: Arthur Benson, a Lawrence native and School of Engineering student, has been named a 2026-2027 Astronaut Scholar. The program awards approximately 60 scholarships annually to sophomores and juniors in STEM who demonstrate exceptional academic performance, significant research experience and a commitment to pursuing a career in research.
title_cn: KU student from Lawrence named Astronaut Scholar

title: Audio-Reader receives 3 awards, honorable mention from the International Association of Audio Information Services
summary_en: Audio-Reader, based at the University of Kansas, was recently honored at the 2026 Annual IAAIS Program Awards presentation. Awarded categories include Newspapers, Magazines, Books/Short Story Programs and the Now Hear This category for short works.
title_cn: Audio-Reader receives 3 awards, honorable mention from the International Association of Audio Information Services
